question: Information handling is the process of collecting, organizing, summarizing, analyzing and:
urdu_translation: information handling collecting، organizing، summarizing، analyzing اور کس process پر مشتمل ہے؟

B: Drawing only triangles / صرف triangles draw کرنا
C: Proving theorems only / صرف theorems prove کرنا
D: Interpreting numerical data / numerical data کو interpret کرنا
correct_answer: D | Interpreting numerical data / numerical data کو interpret کرنا

question: Data that takes only specific countable values is called:
urdu_translation: specific countable values لینے والے data کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟
B: Grouped data only / صرف grouped data

question: Data that can take every possible value in an interval is called:
urdu_translation: interval میں every possible value لینے والے data کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: Ungrouped data is also known as:
urdu_translation: ungrouped data کو اور کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: The number of times a value occurs in data is its:
urdu_translation: data میں value جتنی times occur کرے اسے کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: The difference between the greatest and smallest data values is the:
urdu_translation: greatest اور smallest data values کے difference کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: The smallest value included in a class is its:
urdu_translation: class میں included smallest value کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟

urdu_translation: histogram frequency distribution کو کس کے ذریعے represent کرتا ہے؟

urdu_translation: class کے midpoint کو اور کیا کہتے ہیں؟

urdu_translation: n observations کا arithmetic mean کیا ہے؟

correct_answer: C | Frequency divided by class width / frequency کو class width سے divide کرنا

question: The midpoint of the class 34–38 is:
urdu_translation: class 34–38 کا midpoint کیا ہے؟

question: To close a frequency polygon, its end segments are extended to:
urdu_translation: frequency polygon close کرنے کے لیے end segments کہاں extend کیے جاتے ہیں؟
